correctness.rationale: The normalized weighted-composition edge calculation gives exact squared edge amplitudes. Orthogonality yields the first five basis-vector norms; symbolic rational cancellation produces the displayed strictly negative 3-by-3 determinant for all integers kappa at least three and all positive ratios. Analytic inequalities, not tests of finite samples, prove the infinite-domain result.

The cutoff is independent of arbitrarily long cycles, identifies a natural boundary between two-by-two and three-by-three moment positivity, and quantifies a definite obstruction rather than adding another isolated non-subnormal example.
